newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bonds set to stay static in moribund market.
newsitem.headline: Danish bonds set to stay static in moribund market.

text.p: Danish bond prices were static in a moribund market on Tuesday with dealers seeing no sign of any change or major activity ahead.
"There is no sign of any change in prices or activity. The French poll news did not affect the market, as Paris took it in its stride. Pollsters see a centre-right win," one dealer said.

The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was down a minimal 0.04 point from the start, 0.23 lower than Monday's close yielding 6.62 percent in turnover of 615 million crowns while its June future fell 0.16 point to 108.46 with 80 contracts traded.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 lost 0.12 point to 87.33.
The crown traded at 3.8093 per mark at 1130 gmt, virtually unchanged from around 3.8090 at the opening.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany narrowed one basis point to 73.
